title: Stack Watch
summary: Publish twenty-four current official-source packets with source-bound supported claims, system implications, and excluded inferences.
record_scope: Append-only Phase 161 record over the immutable Phase 145–156 v1-RC baseline.
publication_boundaries: The Phase 157–164 overlay adds operating plans and bounded content without rewriting the immutable Phase 145–156 release candidate.
Future September checks, desk decisions, edition inputs, publication receipts, and month-end findings remain null until their lawful dates.
Alternative official artifacts remain candidate pointers unless a dated authorized adjudication admits them; discovery is not evidence admission.
No project stage, longitudinal observation, outcome, causal finding, score, rank, owner decision, repository publication, hosted deployment, or v1 promotion is inferred.

stack_watch_packets.title: NERC 2025 Long-Term Reliability Assessment
stack_watch_packets.reader_brief: NERC reports that assessment-area summer peak demand is forecast to rise by more than 224 GW from 2025 through 2035 and winter peak demand by about 245 GW. The assessment attributes most projected growth to data centers and distinguishes 71 GW of approved summer-capacity growth from 266 GW of prospective additions. This record sits in the Power and grid watch lane and is linked to Energy, Chips and Compute, Policy and Standards. Named project context includes Northern Virginia Golden-Mars and GS-5 large-load trail. Receiving-place context includes Northern Virginia Data Center Corridor.

stack_watch_packets.title: Queued Up 2026
stack_watch_packets.evidence_type: Official laboratory queue dataset and report
stack_watch_packets.reader_brief: Berkeley Lab identifies about 8,200 active projects representing 1,312 GW of generation and 749 GW of storage at the end of 2025. About 549 GW had a draft or executed interconnection agreement without commercial operation, and the median request-to-operation time exceeded five years for projects completed in 2025. This record sits in the Power and grid watch lane and is linked to Energy, Climate. Named project context includes Manatee Battery Energy Storage Center, Moss Landing battery safety and operation, Gateway battery storage, Hornsdale Power Reserve, Victoria Big Battery, Dalrymple grid battery. Receiving-place context includes South Australia grid storage, Victoria grid storage, Florida utility storage, California battery safety.
